description: This file defines the 'Permission' entity class which models permissions within the user management system of the application. It includes mappings to the database, relationships to groups, and auditing features.

classes.name: Permission
classes.description: Entity class representing a permission, with fields for permission name, associated groups, and audit information. Implements the Auditable interface, provides constructors, and getter/setter methods for fields.

methods.name: Permission
methods.description: Default constructor for the Permission class.

methods.name: Permission
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a Permission with a specific permission name.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the primary key (id) of the permission.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the primary key (id) of the permission.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Retrieves the audit details associated with this permission.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit details for this permission.

methods.name: getPermissionName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the permission.

methods.name: setPermissionName
methods.description: Sets the name of the permission.

methods.name: setGroups
methods.description: Assigns a list of groups associated with this permission.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Returns the list of groups associated with this permission.
